params.body:
`seo-agent`, `link-herstel` and `triage via MCP` sat on the rung **propose** and exist nowhere: no request type, no capability, no runner. That was fourteen of the fleet's fifty-four tasks, and on that rung a chip reads as "press and it happens".

A promise nothing can keep is the same defect as a file that claims to set a header and does not; only the reader differs. They now say what the work is (`write the missing tags`, `read the proposals`, `repair or remove the link`) on the rung that is true, until a hand exists.

A test walks the worklist and asks of every task above `manual` whether its playbook can actually be asked (`PlaybookRequest::exists`), so the next named-but-absent hand fails here instead of on a screen.

Suite green but `BuildStampTest` (worktree only).
params.title: Een chip belooft geen hand
